_readme: All prices are in INR. This is the ONLY inventory your system may use. Do not invent hotels, activities, transport, or prices that are not in `suppliers`. If a request cannot be fulfilled from this catalog, your system should say so rather than fabricate options.

suppliers.name: Backwater Breeze Homestay
suppliers.description: Family-run homestay on the Alleppey backwaters with home-cooked Kerala meals.

suppliers.name: Tea County Resort
suppliers.description: Mid-range resort set among Munnar tea estates with mountain views.

suppliers.name: Fort Kochi Heritage Inn
suppliers.description: Restored heritage inn in Fort Kochi near cafes and the waterfront.

suppliers.name: Munnar Hikers Hostel
suppliers.description: No-frills budget stay popular with hikers, close to trailheads.

suppliers.name: Alleppey Houseboat Day Cruise
suppliers.description: Traditional houseboat cruise through the backwaters with lunch included.

suppliers.name: Munnar Tea Estate Walk & Tasting
suppliers.description: Guided walk through a working tea estate with a tasting session.

suppliers.name: Eravikulam National Park Trek
suppliers.description: Guided trek in Eravikulam National Park; moderate difficulty.

suppliers.name: Fort Kochi Food Walk
suppliers.description: Evening street-food and heritage walk through Fort Kochi.

suppliers.name: Kathakali Performance Evening
suppliers.description: Classical Kathakali dance performance with makeup demonstration.

suppliers.name: Private Cab (Sedan, per day)
suppliers.description: Air-conditioned sedan with driver, per-day hire across Kerala.

suppliers.name: Private Cab (SUV, per day)
suppliers.description: Air-conditioned SUV with driver, per-day hire; suits larger families.

suppliers.name: Kochi Airport Transfer
suppliers.description: One-way private airport transfer within the Kochi region.

past_trips.feedback: Loved the estate stay and unhurried schedule; kids got bored on the long drives.
Great food and homestay; wanted more nature walks and fewer packed days.

test_requests.text: 5 days in Kerala for a family of 4 (2 adults, kids aged 8 and 11), mid-range budget around 60,000 total, we love nature and local food and prefer a relaxed pace.
test_requests.note_for_reviewer: Happy path. Strong answers use the past-trip feedback (relaxed pace, more nature, fewer long drives) to shape the itinerary, keep the total near budget, and cite every item used.

test_requests.text: A weekend in Munnar for a couple, budget-conscious, we're into hiking and tea estates.
test_requests.note_for_reviewer: Tests retrieval precision and budget sensitivity: should surface the budget hostel, the trek, and the tea walk rather than the mid-range resort.

test_requests.text: Plan me a 3-day beach trip to Goa with nightlife.
test_requests.note_for_reviewer: GROUNDING TRAP. There is no Goa inventory in the catalog. A strong system must decline gracefully / flag that it cannot fulfill this from available inventory, and MUST NOT invent Goa hotels, prices, or activities. Hallucinating here is a serious red flag.
